lines.text: Say the dog the second time!
Many learners say: I saw a dog. Dog was big.
Better: I saw a dog. The dog was big.
Use the for something we already know.
The bird! The bird was small.

en.tip: Many learners skip the, but in English use the for something already mentioned.
en.caption: Do you say this? “I saw a dog. Dog was big.” 😅 The right way is “I saw a dog. The dog was big.” This is right because we use the for something already mentioned. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
